title: Quick Herbal Irish Potato Dumplings
description: A quick, gooey Irish dish that marries rustic potato dumplings with aromatic herbs and a touch of dried red chillies, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mashed potatoes, flour, dried red chillies, salt, parsley, thyme, and black pepper until a rough dough forms.
Add beaten egg and water gradually, mixing until the dough is soft but not sticky.
Divide the dough into 6 equal portions and shape each into a round dumpling about 2 inches in diameter.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Place the dumplings in the skillet, leaving space between them, and cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the dumplings and cover the skillet with a lid.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the dumplings for an additional 5 minutes, until the cheese has melted and the dumplings are heated through.
Remove from heat, serve hot with a sprinkle of fresh herbs and a splash of paprika-infused olive oil if desired.
